sentences.en: The dorsad reduction maneuver has been used for treating 120 cases of posticous cervical spondylopathy and 90 cases treated with common massage has been used as control.

sentences.en: Objectives:To observe the effect of the combination therapy of electric acupuncture and moxibustion on cervical spondylopathy. To probe into the psychological and rheological mechanism of it.

sentences.en: His empirical presecription "Niubangzi Decoction" was used to treat cervical spondylopathy, ischemic necrosis of femoral head and knee osteoarthritis.

sentences.en: By multiple factor analysis, abnormal posture, emotional tension, moisture and fatigue were the main inducing factors of incidence of cervical spondylopathy.
sentences.vi: Bằng cách phân tích nhiều yếu tố, tư thế bất thường, căng thẳng cảm xúc, ẩm ướt và mệt mỏi là những yếu tố chính gây ra tỷ lệ mắc bệnh thoái hóa đốt sống cổ.
